components.name: Two-stop Route
components.description: Equal-width Overview and Updates destinations with an iris selection line.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 11px 14px 0; background: #F5F6F4; font: 12px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-route-stop { position: relative; flex: 1; padding: 0 6px 9px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #62686F; cursor: pointer; } .ds-route-stop::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 6px; bottom: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; } .ds-route-stop-selected { color: #111315; font-weight: 600; } .ds-route-stop-selected::after { background: #5E54F6; } .ds-route-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5E54F6; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Actionable Update Summary
components.description: The strongest Overview field when one or more packages can be updated.
components.html: ↓2 updates availableReview one update or approve them all.
components.css: .ds-update-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 14px; border-radius: 9px; background: #F2B84B; color: #111315; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-update-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 19px; height: 19px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-update-copy { display: grid; gap: 2px; flex: 1; } .ds-update-copy strong { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-update-copy small { font-size: 10px; opacity: .78; } .ds-update-summary button { padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(17,19,21,.45); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); color: inherit; font: 500 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-update-summary button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.42); } .ds-update-summary button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5E54F6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Overview Fact Row
components.description: A flat, divided row for Homebrew version or installed total.
components.css: .ds-fact-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #D9DDDA; color: #111315; font: 12px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; background: #F5F6F4; } .ds-fact-icon { width: 20px; color: #5E54F6; text-align: center; } .ds-fact-row strong { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Available Update Row
components.description: An actionable package row with its exact version change and an individual review control.
components.css: .ds-update-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #D9DDDA; background: #F5F6F4; color: #111315; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-row-icon { color: #6B4300; font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-copy { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row-copy strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row-copy small { overflow: hidden; color: #62686F; font: 10px/1.25 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-update-row button { padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid #B9BDC1; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111315; font: 500 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-update-row button:hover { background: #F0F1EF; } .ds-update-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5E54F6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Trust and Freshness
components.description: The quiet Overview ending that keeps the confirmation promise and check time together.
components.html: ✓ Nothing runs without confirmation.Last checked 2 minutes ago
components.css: .ds-trust { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 14px; color: #62686F; background: #F5F6F4; font: 10px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-trust span { font-weight: 500; } .ds-trust time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
BrewPulse treats package maintenance like calm public infrastructure. Neutral surroundings keep the interface quiet. A clear iris route shows location, and amber appears only when there is work to review.

The app answers a few concrete questions, makes the next action obvious, and shows the exact Homebrew command before anything runs. It should never feel like a Terminal wrapper, an inventory database, or a coffee-themed utility.
keyCharacteristics: Native macOS controls and SF typography
Iris navigation and an approved raster mug identity

rules.name: The signal rule
rules.body: Iris means identity or interaction. Amber means an update can be reviewed. Green means no work is needed. Red means failure or destruction. Do not swap these roles.

rules.name: The native scale rule
rules.body: Use semantic SwiftUI text styles so accessibility sizes remain intact. Fixed sizing is reserved for the 19-point status icon and the 34-point initial-error symbol.

rules.name: The two-stop rule
rules.body: The popover has exactly two destinations: Overview and Updates. New package-maintenance detail belongs in one of those destinations or in a focused review or output window.

rules.name: The flat-inside rule
rules.body: A surface may change tone to communicate state, but it does not lift away from the popover.

dos: Do derive Overview, Updates, and Update All from the same actionable update collection.
Do keep "Nothing runs without confirmation" and the latest check time together near the bottom of Overview.
Do disable package actions when the visible data is a retained snapshot after refresh failure.
Do let Homebrew output stay technical and exact.
donts: Don't bring back installed Cask or Formula browsing in the popover.
Don't redraw, approximate, or replace the approved mug with an SF Symbol or custom SwiftUI geometry.
Don't build a grid of statistic cards or use a giant hero number.
Don't let Review All execute immediately.
Don't count pinned, self-updating, disabled, unavailable, or metadata-blocked packages as actionable updates.
